outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows H&E-stained tissue micrographs, not a plot.

Panel C contains a box plot (top, exempt from the requirement since it already shows distribution) and a 3D bar chart of mean polyp number per mouse by diameter category (bottom). The bar chart represents averaged data (n=8-18 mice per genotype) but shows only bars with no overlaid individual mouse data points, so the requirement is not met for this panel.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E includes western blots and a bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 relative to total; the bar chart shows only mean bars without individual data points overlaid.
Panel F shows immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot.
Panel G includes western blots/zymography and a bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars and significance markers, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
